content.text: American golfer Xander Schauffele, who claimed victory at Royal Troon in Scotland in 2024, is the reigning champion of The Open.
Ireland's Shane Lowry won The Open at Portrush in 2019 amid raucous scenes of celebration on the 18th green.

The defending champion is American Xander Schauffele, who faces competition from 156 players vying for the Claret Jug and the title of 'Champion Golfer of the Year'. Shane Lowry of Ireland was the titleholder during the last championship held at Portrush in 2019.
